resources.string: For a diagram input change s, ON change = s and OFF change = −s. Zero means no change from the diagram reference. Matching sizes make the signs easy to compare; these are not measured gains or shares of a divided signal.

In the main dim-light rod pathway, a rod bipolar cell sends input to an AII amacrine cell. Follow two connections out from AII: an electrical gap junction to an ON cone bipolar cell preserves the sign of the change; a glycinergic inhibitory synapse to an OFF cone bipolar cell reverses it in this sketch. The diagram shows only the rod-driven direction of the relay. The numbers are invented diagram units (u), not light levels, voltages, firing rates, or visual predictions.
